INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Only memorise without using the language
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

2. When practising Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.

3. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making.

   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening.

   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Mechanics of writing.

----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
